_README: Comment + Joseph-reply single posts (the 'top comment' format). Each answers a real-style question in his voice. enabled:true => rotates into the AM single-post slot.

comment.author: creator_mike
comment.text: how do you make every video feel different? mine all blur together

reply.author: Joseph Borroto
reply.text: same energy, new angle every time. one idea, told 5 ways. never reinvent — re-angle.

entries.caption:
Your videos blur together because you reinvent every post. Don't. One idea, new angle.
